sentences.text:
Hon'ble Dr. Gautam Chowdhary,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned A.G.A. for the State.

The present 482 Cr.P.C. application has been filed praying for quashing of charge sheet dated 25.08.2019 under Sections 420, 406, 354, 504, 506 I.P.C. in Case No. 4752 of 2019 (State Versus Nanhe Pal and others) arising out of Case Crime No. 0131 of 2019, Police Station Bhojipur, District Bareilly as well as order of cognizance and summoning dated 07.11.2019 passed by Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Court No. 7, Bareilly and order of N.B.W. dated 08.11.2023 passed by A.C.J.
(S.D.)-Ist, Bareilly.

The contention of learned counsel for the applicant is that no offence against the applicants is disclosed and the present prosecution has been instituted with a malafide intention for the purpose of causing harassment.

He pointed out certain documents and statements in support of his Nanhe Pal And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 14 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/9481271/
1 contention.

entities.text: Nanhe Pal And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Having heard the learned counsel for the applicants and perused the materials brought on record, it does not appear to be a fit case praying for quashing of impugned order.
The prayer praying for quashing of same is hereby refused, at this stage as the argument raised by learned counsel for the applicants involves factual disputes and appraisal of evidence.

However, looking at the nature of offence alleged and attending facts and circumstances of the case,
as have been brought on record, it is directed that if the applicants appear and surrenders before the court below within two weeks from today and apply for bail, his prayer for bail shall be considered and decided in accordance with law.
For a period of two weeks from today, the non-bailable warrant issued against the applicants shall be kept in abeyance.
The present application stands disposed of.

Order Date :- 14.6.2024 T.S.
